floor_from.why_halved: a stock drawn larger than life is resampled and a resample only smooths: magnifying the same stock by three takes 0.671 to 0.508, a factor of 0.76

negative_control.note: the literal Container colour that used to stand in for a sheet in authoring.dart

the_one_it_used_to_get_wrong: the sky of the photograph open in 14_media_viewer. It is pale, warm enough to pass the colour test, and it is content rather than a surface this build answers for; an anti-goal critic reproduced the old numbers and disagreed with that verdict, correctly. A filter that excluded it by how busy its surroundings are also excluded every real slab, so it was named here instead. Against the derived floor it no longer trips: the sky's flattest window reads 0.619, which is above 0.363, because a photograph of the sky through a lens still carries sensor grain and a flat fill carries nothing.
quiet_is_not_flat: windows_quieter_than_2 is what this check used to gate on, kept because four cycles of reports carry it. It is not a fault: receipt stock's own median window is under it, and the 05_settings windows it names are lined writing paper with its tooth plainly in the crop.
